subject: Mindfulness and Boston Cares Bed Project
overview: Medford High School students presented the twentieth Mustang Report, featuring the launch of a new mindfulness and meditation program and a community service partnership with Boston Cares to build beds for local families.

items.title: Episode Introduction
items.summary: Lydia Ryan and fellow students celebrated the twentieth edition of the news program with yoga and school spirit countdowns.

items.title: Mindfulness Program Interview
items.summary: Gigi Braga interviewed instructor Julie Grimm about a new meditation program offering twice-weekly sessions to help students and teachers manage stress.

items.title: Field Base Installation Segment
items.summary: A brief instructional clip demonstrated the proper placement and maintenance of pre-assembled base foundations for sports fields.

items.title: Question of the Week
items.summary: Gigi Braga posed a trivia question regarding the number of marathons she has completed.

items.title: Boston Cares Project Overview
items.summary: Lydia Ryan interviewed construction teacher Mr. Brown regarding a team-building initiative where volunteers from Nuance and vocational students fabricated beds for needy families.

items.title: Vocational Student Interviews
items.summary: Vocational students Sean and Noah explained their roles in painting and assembling materials for the Boston Cares project to help homeless families.

items.title: April Fools' Day Skits
items.summary: Students concluded the report by filming several April Fools' Day pranks involving false college acceptances and school cancellations.
